title: Session: 2.43.0 mod mail review
objective: Review 2.43.0 on owner-authorized staging: members open a private case with /modmail or the dashboard's Open a case form, officers answer on the Mod mail page, pings and DMs carry only the case number and a link, and closed cases expire after 90 days. Adds migration 014 and the optional MODMAIL_KEY setting; the deploy registers /modmail in DevBot's guild. Preserve one DevBot writer; production requires separate readiness and GitHub approval.
user: Before upgrading, make a key with openssl rand -base64 32, keep a copy off the host and add MODMAIL_KEY to staging; review the digest and backups. 2.43.0 adds 014_modmail.sql (going back needs the pre-migration backup) and registers /modmail.

Allow the TaruBot role Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles in the officer notifications channel; turn mod mail on. Open cases with /modmail and with Open a case on the dashboard; both say all officers can read it.

The ping notifies officers with only the case number and link; reply as the officers; the member's DM and page show The officers; close and reopen by replying. Timed out, /modmail is gone but the dashboard still works.
Without Administrator, allow Mention Everyone on TaruBot's own entry in that channel, drift another role's View there, run the onboarding pass (dry run, then apply): it applies with no refusal.
Open another member's case number (a plain 404), check the read log; approve production only after its own baseline and key.
assistant: Before release, run the full suite with disposable PostgreSQL, the version gate and the documentation site build; the mod mail tests use invented data and keys derived from phrases.
Diagnose owner-reported results, preserve scope and record exercised verification separately from unverified live acceptance.
Perform no live host, token, key, database, Discord, environment or deployment operations. This plan grants no live-operation authorization.
bot: Run one DevBot instance under the staging profile, with effects initially paused and strict managed-database/test-guild guards.
Keep mod mail off until an officer turns it on; encrypt every topic and message with MODMAIL_KEY, and report only whether the key is valid.

Ping the officer role in the officer notifications channel (Mention Everyone allowed there only) and DM the member with a case number and a link only, at most once per case per 10 minutes, waiting while Discord changes are paused.
Delete closed cases 90 days after closing, under the writer lease; keep the status samples and role choices as in 2.41.0 and 2.40.0.
Expose database, Discord and writer-lease readiness; report 2.43.0, startup time and effect state without pinging members.
